summary: The candidate is a verified partial fix: it adds per-process, per-bootstrap exponential backoff and an eight-attempt terminal abort, eliminating the unbounded retry loop for an individual pending cohort. It does not coordinate once per node, and the exact two-node TP8/EP8/DP8 Errno 99 and successful-serving outcome could not be exercised in this environment.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before: base had no retry gate method, submitted three calls in three rapid cycles, and made ten calls in ten cycles rather than terminating after three.
At exact candidate commit: 12 focused queue-cleanup and bootstrap lookup tests passed.
At exact candidate commit: 361 disaggregation tests and 45 subtests passed.
Eight-attempt terminal bound and abort; recovery on the eighth attempt; eight initial calls across eight independent queues; fresh retry budget for a later cohort.
Three candidate report text files contain trailing whitespace; no runtime source whitespace error was reported.

gpu_evidence: rocminfo reports one gfx950 AMD Instinct MI355X, but the reviewed retry path is CPU-side and the required two-node, 16-GPU distributed topology and model weights were unavailable.
remaining_counterexamples: Retry and throttle state remains local to each decode queue/process; eight DP ranks can issue eight initial calls and up to 64 calls for one unresolved cohort rather than one node-wide query.
After a cohort reaches the retry cap and is aborted, a later cohort for the same permanently unreachable bootstrap receives a fresh retry budget; there is no persistent address-level circuit breaker.
No two-node Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 TP8/EP8/DP8 MoRI run demonstrates that the reported Errno 99 exhaustion is eliminated and requests complete successfully.
remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was available; the original setup requires two MI355X nodes with eight GPUs per role.
Qwen/Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 weights and the reported MoRI distributed topology were unavailable.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The candidate diff has trailing whitespace in three report artifact files.
